name: local-ai-proxy-mac-client
description: Runs on the Mac: keeps an outbound WSS tunnel to the local-ai-proxy microservice and relays OpenAI requests to the local LM Studio server

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
